Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.subtitle: What data UniLink collects, how it is used, with whom it is shared, and the choices and rights you have.
Privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how UniLink collects, uses, stores, shares, licenses and protects personal data when you use our website, applications and related services. It forms part of our Terms of Service. By ticking the acceptance box when you register, or by using the Service, you confirm that you have read this Policy and that you give the consents described in it, including consent to the sharing of your data with universities, partners and service providers. Please read it carefully.

sections.heading: Introduction and Scope
sections.body:
This Privacy Policy (the “Policy”) applies to all personal data that UniLink (“UniLink”, “we”, “us” or “our”) collects about you when you visit or use the UniLink website, applications, tools and related services (together, the “Service”), when you communicate with us, and when we receive data about you from third parties. It applies to students, parents and guardians, representatives of institutions and partners, and all other visitors.

We process personal data in accordance with the Egyptian Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020 and its executive regulations (the “PDPL”), and with any other law that applies to us. Capitalized words that are not defined in this Policy have the meanings given to them in our Terms of Service.

sections.heading: Who Is Responsible for Your Data
sections.body:
UniLink is the controller of the personal data described in this Policy, which means that we decide why and how it is processed. Where we share personal data with an institution or partner that uses it for its own purposes, that recipient becomes an independent controller of the data it receives and is responsible for its own processing under its own privacy policy.

You can contact us about any matter relating to this Policy or your personal data using the details in the Contact Us section. Where the law requires us to appoint a data protection officer, that officer can be reached at the same address.

sections.heading: Key Terms
sections.body:
“Personal data” means any data relating to an identified natural person, or one who can be identified directly or indirectly, for example by a name, an identification number, contact details, location data, an online identifier, or factors specific to their physical, educational, economic or social identity.
“Processing” means any operation performed on personal data, including collection, recording, organization, storage, adaptation, retrieval, use, disclosure, transfer, combination, restriction, erasure and destruction.
“Aggregated or de-identified data” means data that has been combined, summarized or altered so that it no longer identifies you and cannot reasonably be linked back to you. Such data is not personal data.
“Partners” means universities and other educational institutions, education agencies, scholarship and financing providers, advertisers, marketing and research partners, and other organizations with which UniLink has a commercial or data relationship.

sections.heading: Data You Give Us
sections.body:
We collect the data you provide when you register, complete your profile, use the Service or contact us, including:
• Identity and contact data: your first and last name, email address, phone number, the role you register as (for example student or parent), and, for password accounts, a securely hashed version of your password.
• Academic and study profile: your secondary-certificate system, grades or scores, graduation year, intended study level, fields of study, preferred institutions, intake, English test type and score, nationality, and budget range.
• Preferences and activity you choose to record: universities, faculties and programs you save, compare, rate or review, and application plans and statuses you track.
• Content you submit: ratings, reviews, messages, forms (for example partnership or demo requests), and any profile picture or other image you upload.
• Information about others: if you register on behalf of a student, or give us details of another person, the data you provide about them.
• Communications: the content of messages you send us and our replies.

Some of this data is required to create an Account or to use certain features; we will tell you which. If you do not provide it, we may not be able to provide those features.

sections.heading: Data We Collect Automatically
sections.body:
When you use the Service, we and our service providers automatically collect technical and usage data, including:
• Device and connection data: IP address, browser type and version, operating system, device type, language settings, approximate location derived from the IP address, and referring website.
• Usage data: pages and profiles you view, searches you run and their results, filters you apply, items you click, save or compare, the time and duration of visits, and errors.
• Account security data: sign-in times, session identifiers and records of security events, such as password changes.
• Cookies and similar technologies: as described in the Cookies section below.

We use this data to operate and secure the Service, to understand how it is used, and to create statistics, analytics and Platform Data.

sections.heading: Data We Receive From Third Parties
Location Data
sections.body:
Some features, such as finding the universities nearest to you, can use your device’s location or a point you select on a map. Precise location is only accessed if you grant permission in your browser. For the nearest-university feature, distances are calculated on your device; we do not need to store your precise location, it is not placed in the page address, and it is not sent to UniLink’s servers to provide that feature. Map images are loaded from third-party map providers, such as OpenStreetMap, which receive your IP address and the map area being displayed in order to deliver the map.

We may also infer an approximate city or region from your IP address, or use the city and governorate you enter in your profile, to personalize content and to produce statistics. You can withdraw location permission at any time in your browser settings.

sections.heading: Keeping Your Data Accurate
sections.body: We rely on you to provide accurate, complete and current information and to update it when it changes. Your study profile, grades and preferences directly affect the recommendations, matches and estimates you receive, and the information shared with institutions and partners. You can review and update most of your data at any time from your Profile page. If you notice that data we hold about you is wrong and you cannot correct it yourself, please contact us.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Data
Legal Bases and Your Consent
sections.body:
We process your personal data on the basis of your consent, which you give by accepting the Terms of Service and this Policy when you register, and which a parent or guardian gives on behalf of a User under 18. Where the law allows, we also process personal data where it is necessary to perform our agreement with you, to comply with a legal obligation, or to protect the legitimate interests of UniLink, our Users or third parties, such as keeping the Service secure, preventing fraud, and improving the Service.

By accepting this Policy you expressly consent to the collection, processing, combination, transfer, disclosure, sharing and licensing of your personal data as described in it, including sharing with institutions and partners, use for marketing, and transfer outside the Arab Republic of Egypt. Where a particular use requires separate consent under the law, we will ask for it separately.

sections.heading: Recommendations, Profiling and Automated Processing
sections.body:
To personalize the Service, we use automated processing to analyse your profile, preferences, searches and activity. For example, we compare your certificate system and grades with published minimum scores, match your fields of interest and budget with programs, rank results by relevance or distance, and identify programs and institutions that may interest you. We may also group Users into segments, for example by field of interest, region or budget, to tailor content, to produce statistics, and to help institutions and partners reach suitable prospective students.

These automated outputs are guidance only. UniLink does not make admission decisions, and no automated decision made by UniLink produces legal effects concerning you or similarly significantly affects you. Admission decisions are made by institutions under their own rules. If you have a question about how a recommendation was produced, you can contact us.

sections.heading: Platform Data and De-identified Data
sections.body:
When your data is aggregated with data from other Users, or de-identified so that it no longer identifies you, it becomes Platform Data. As set out in the Terms of Service, UniLink owns all rights in Platform Data and in the databases, compilations, analytics and insights it creates, and may use, publish, sell, license, share and transfer them for any lawful purpose, including commercial purposes, without further notice or consent. Examples include statistics on demand for fields and programs, trends in searches and saved items by region, and anonymized benchmarks provided to institutions.

We take reasonable steps so that de-identified data cannot be used to re-identify you, and we require recipients of such data not to attempt to re-identify individuals.

sections.heading: Who We Share Your Data With
sections.body:
With your consent given by accepting this Policy, we may share your personal data with the following recipients:
• Institutions: universities, faculties and colleges you show interest in, or whose programs match your profile, preferences or searches, so that they can contact you, provide information, assess eligibility and offer you admission opportunities, scholarships and events.
• Partners: education agencies, scholarship and financing providers, test and training providers, and other partners offering products or services relevant to students, for their own marketing and service purposes, and advertising, marketing and research partners who help us and our partners reach and understand students.
• Service providers: companies that process data on our behalf, such as hosting and cloud providers, database and file-storage providers, email and messaging services, sign-in and security services, analytics, customer support, and professional advisers such as lawyers, auditors and consultants.
• Affiliates: companies that control, are controlled by, or are under common control with UniLink.
• Business transferees: any actual or prospective buyer, investor, lender, successor or merger partner, and their advisers, in connection with a sale, merger, financing, reorganization or transfer of all or part of our business or assets.
• Authorities and others: courts, regulators, law-enforcement and other competent authorities where required by law, and others where needed to establish, exercise or defend legal claims or to protect rights, safety and property.
• Others with your direction: anyone else, where you ask us to share your data or use a feature designed to share it, such as publishing a review.

Public content, such as reviews and ratings you publish, may be visible to other Users and the public. Recipients that receive your data for their own purposes process it under their own privacy policies, and we encourage you to read them.

sections.heading: How We Protect Data We Share
sections.body:
When we share personal data with service providers, we require them by contract to process it only on our instructions, to keep it confidential and secure, and to delete or return it when the service ends. When we share personal data with institutions and partners for their own purposes, we share only the data reasonably relevant to the purpose, we require them to use it lawfully and in line with the PDPL, to respect opt-out requests, and not to resell identifiable data unless the law allows it and you have consented, and we may audit or stop sharing with a recipient that does not meet these requirements.

We keep records of the categories of data shared and of the recipients, so that we can respond to your requests and to the competent authority.

sections.heading: Commercial Use of Data
sections.body: UniLink is a business, and the data generated through the Service helps us to provide the Service, often free of charge. You agree that we may use and share personal data, and use, sell and license Platform Data, as part of commercial arrangements with institutions and partners, for example providing institutions with lists of interested and matching prospective students, lead-generation services, sponsored listings and promotions, demand reports and market insights. Where the sharing of identifiable personal data is part of such an arrangement, it is carried out on the basis of the consent you gave by accepting this Policy, and you may withdraw that consent for future sharing at any time.

sections.heading: International Transfers
sections.body: Our service providers and partners may be located, or may store and process data, outside the Arab Republic of Egypt, including in countries whose data protection laws may differ from Egyptian law. By accepting this Policy you consent to the transfer of your personal data to those countries. Where the PDPL requires a licence, permit or specific safeguards for a cross-border transfer, we will obtain them or put them in place, for example through contractual commitments that require the recipient to protect the data to a standard no lower than the one required by Egyptian law.

sections.heading: Cookies and Similar Technologies
sections.body:
We use cookies, local storage and similar technologies that are necessary for the Service to work, such as keeping you signed in, remembering your language, protecting against fraud and abuse, and recording the use of free searches by visitors who are not signed in. We may also use cookies and similar technologies for preferences, analytics, measurement and, with your consent where required, advertising.

You can control cookies through your browser settings, and you can delete stored cookies at any time. If you block necessary cookies, some parts of the Service may not work.

sections.heading: Marketing Communications
sections.body:
With the consent you give by accepting this Policy, we and, where described above, institutions and partners may send you marketing communications about programs, admissions, scholarships, events, products and services by email, SMS, phone, messaging applications or notifications.

You can opt out of marketing at any time by using the unsubscribe link in a message, by replying STOP where offered, or by contacting us. Opting out of UniLink’s marketing does not automatically stop marketing from an institution or partner that has already received your data for its own purposes; you can contact that recipient directly to opt out. We will continue to send you service messages, such as security and account notices.

sections.heading: How Long We Keep Your Data
sections.body:
We keep personal data for as long as your Account is active and for as long as needed for the purposes described in this Policy, including providing the Service, maintaining records of your consents, resolving disputes, enforcing our agreements, and complying with legal, accounting and reporting obligations.

When personal data is no longer needed, we delete it, destroy it, or de-identify it so that it no longer identifies you. De-identified and aggregated data, and Platform Data, may be kept and used indefinitely. Data that has already been shared with institutions or partners for their own purposes is retained by them under their own policies. Backups may keep data for a limited period before they are overwritten.

sections.heading: How We Protect Your Data
sections.body:
We use technical and organizational measures designed to protect personal data against accidental or unlawful loss, access, use, alteration and disclosure. These include encrypted connections to the Service, storing passwords only as salted cryptographic hashes, access controls that limit administrative access to authorized personnel, validation of uploaded files, rate limiting, and monitoring for abuse.

No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security. You are responsible for keeping your login details safe. If we become aware of a personal data breach that the law requires us to report, we will notify the competent authority and, where required, the affected Users, within the periods set by the PDPL.

sections.heading: Children and Minors
sections.body:
The Service is designed for prospective university students, many of whom are under 18. A User under 18 may only use the Service with the consent of a parent or legal guardian, who gives the consents in this Policy on the minor’s behalf, including consent to the sharing of the minor’s data with institutions and partners. We do not knowingly allow children under 13 to create Accounts.

If you are a parent or guardian and believe that a minor has provided data without your consent, please contact us so that we can take appropriate action, which may include deleting the data or closing the Account.

sections.heading: Information for Parents and Guardians
sections.body: If you register as a parent or guardian, or manage an Account for a student, we process your own identity and contact data as well as the data you provide about the student. You confirm that you have the authority to provide the student’s data and to give the consents in this Policy on their behalf. You can exercise the student’s rights on their behalf while they are a minor. When the student reaches 18, they may exercise their rights directly, and we may ask them to confirm their consent to continued processing.

sections.heading: Data of Institution Representatives and Partners
sections.body: If you contact us, apply for a partnership, request a demo, or use the Service on behalf of an institution or partner, we process your name, job title, organization, email address, phone number, the content of your request, and records of your activity in any administrative tools. We use this data to manage the relationship, to review and respond to requests, to provide administrative access, to keep records of changes made through the Service, to send related communications, and for our legitimate business interests. We may share it within UniLink, with our service providers, and with the organization you represent.

sections.heading: Your Rights
How to Make a Request
sections.body:
To exercise any of your rights, send your request to the contact address below, using the email address associated with your Account where possible. Please state your full name, the email address or phone number registered with us, the right you wish to exercise, and any details that help us find the relevant data. If you are acting for a student or another person, please explain your relationship and authority.

We may ask for additional information to verify your identity, to protect your data from unauthorized requests. We will acknowledge your request and respond within the period required by the PDPL. Exercising your rights is free of charge, except where the law allows a fee, for example for repeated or excessive requests, in which case we will tell you before charging it.

sections.heading: Withdrawing Consent and Closing Your Account
sections.body:
You may withdraw your consent, or ask us to close your Account and delete your personal data, at any time by contacting us. When we receive a valid request, we will stop the processing to which the withdrawal applies and delete or de-identify your personal data, except data we must or may keep under the law.

Withdrawal applies to future processing only. It does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before it, data that has already been shared with institutions or partners for their own purposes, data already published at your request (such as a review, which may be de-identified rather than removed), or Platform Data and other aggregated or de-identified data. Because the Service depends on processing your data, withdrawing consent may mean that we can no longer provide some or all of the Service to you.

sections.heading: Third-Party Websites and Services
sections.body: The Service links to and integrates with third-party websites and services, such as institution websites, Google sign-in, OpenStreetMap maps and navigation services. When you use them, the third party collects and processes data under its own privacy policy, which we do not control. We are not responsible for the practices of these third parties and encourage you to review their policies.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Policy from time to time to reflect changes to the Service, our business or the law. We will update the “Last updated” date at the top of the page and notify you of material changes by a notice on the Service, by email, or by asking you to review and accept the updated Policy. Where the law requires your new consent, we will ask for it.

sections.heading: Complaints
sections.body: If you are concerned about how we handle your personal data, please contact us first and we will try to resolve your concern. You also have the right to file a complaint with the Personal Data Protection Center in the Arab Republic of Egypt, or any other competent authority.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: For any question about this Policy, to exercise your rights, to withdraw consent, or to opt out of marketing, please contact us at hello@unilink.example. Please include enough information for us to identify your Account and understand your request.
